results.title: OnePlus, Realme ColorOS 17 Update: When Will Your Phone Get Android 17? Check Full Rollout Schedule, Eligible Devices and Release Dates
results.description: OnePlus and Realme have announced rollout schedules for their Android 17-based ColorOS 17 update, with the first eligible devices set to receive it from October 29, 2026. The rollout will continue through early 2027, covering flagship smartphones, Nord and Narzo models, and select tablets. The post OnePlus, Realme ColorOS 17 Update: When Will Your Phone Get Android 17? Check Full Rollout Schedule, Eligible Devices and Release Dates appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.
